summary.text: Kris Kobach is Kansas's Republican Attorney General, seeking a second term. He served as Kansas Secretary of State from 2011 to 2019 and has been Attorney General since 2023; his campaign emphasizes lower crime rates, a fentanyl task force, and lawsuits against federal policy.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University, a graduate degree from Oxford University and a law degree from Yale University.
Clerked on the Tenth Circuit, taught constitutional law at the University of Missouri at Kansas City, and was counsel to U.S. Attorney General John Ashcroft.
Kansas Secretary of State 2011-2019; Attorney General since 2023.
